About me

Building thoughtful and inclusive learning experiences

I am an education professional with experience in curriculum development, instructional delivery, academic research, content creation, and visual communication. I am currently pursuing a Master of Education in Educational Evaluation and Research at the Institute of Education and Research, University of Dhaka.

My work connects classroom practice with research and creative design. From teaching English and mathematics to young learners, to collecting and transcribing research data, developing children’s books, and coordinating branding, I bring curiosity, care, and strong organization to every project.

EmpathyUnderstanding different learners and communities.
EvidenceMaking decisions through careful research.
CreativityTurning ideas into engaging materials.

Language Education

My Bachelor of Education focused on Language Education, where I achieved first position in the stream with a CGPA of 3.88. My interests include learner-centred language teaching, classroom communication, age-appropriate materials, and engaging content for children.

Educational Research

I am specializing in Educational Evaluation and Research in my Master of Education. My research experience includes field data collection, enumeration, transcription, classroom observation, and work with teachers and primary-education stakeholders for CPD and University Grants Commission projects.
